theorem: The W33 cut lattice supplies a natural integral odd-q companion correspondence module. Its rank is 39=24+15, and the signed-turn restriction has eigenvalues 4 and 10. Therefore S=K-4I is integral and satisfies S(S-6)=0 exactly. The two saturated eigenlattices have gluing quotient (Z/2)^5 plus (Z/6)^10, so the three-primary interface is (Z/3)^10. The exponent ten is exactly Phi_4(3)=3^2+1. This realizes the correct gap-six nodal order on a canonical W33 lattice while simultaneously disproving an identification with the parallel cyclotomic qutrit flat block, whose three-primary rank is four.
